economy.scope: Client-observed wallet deltas and stash sale quotes from authenticated APIs. Final balances may include active raids; stash quotes exclude deployed/overflow equipment, attachments and future insurance. Returned bring-in items are not counted as newly recovered loot. Phase attribution is observational, not the server audit ledger. Conservation checks validate observer arithmetic, not fraud resistance.

scope: Six synthetic persistent accounts: one per map/strategy. Normal public geometry, authenticated API actions, AI/PvP, loot/search/protection, 45-second disconnect exposure and real settlement/trading; no granted loot, movement, damage or outcomes. Recovery kits for both strategies. Loot is sold while original starter items remain untouched. No contracts, insurance, paid equipment or network impairment. Different unseeded raids/spawns and small cohort prevent human balance or universal strategy-dominance conclusions. Final drain time is included in hourly rates.
